contents: Colour 16 mm, 1968. Children at the 'Garden of Children' orphanage (sign: 'sponsored by 2146th Communications Gp', a USAF unit) carry water, play with US airmen in caps, pile onto a red tractor in the fields, get a medical check-up, ring a bell, eat at long tables, and dance in a ring in the yard. Vivid late-60s colour and clothing. Has an audible original magnetic soundtrack (Army news-release narration or music, not checked); mute or replace it if in doubt.
